# Simon Klug

> Simon Klug writes about artificial intelligence, education, software, theatre, and learning. He works on AI and digitalisation at Bosch in Karlsruhe, Germany, and offers workshops and talks.

## About Simon

- [About Simon](https://simonklug.de/about): Background and topics covered on this site.
- [Work and AI](https://simonklug.de/working): Simon's work in AI and digitalisation.

## Workshops and talks

- [Workshops and communication training](https://simonklug.de/enabling): Examples include storytelling, presentation skills, stage confidence, science communication, and improvisation. Simon also runs workshops with Samuel Wagner through [Doppeldenken](https://doppeldenken.de).
- [Work with Simon](https://simonklug.de/offering): Workshops, talks, theatre, and AI in education.

## Writing

The home page lists articles about AI, education, software, theatre, and learning.

- [All writing](https://simonklug.de/)
